categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the paper industry, including pulp manufacturing, paper production, paper container manufacturing, processed paper, and household and sanitary paper products. It also engages in related sectors such as printing plate manufacturing, cogeneration, automation equipment engineering, telecommunications equipment installation, wholesale of building materials, machinery, electrical appliances, software, supermarkets, parking lot operations, real estate development, advertising, product design, non-destructive testing, waste removal and recycling, renewable energy generation, and medical equipment wholesale and retail.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced papermaking technologies including vacuum systems, automated production lines, and energy-efficient equipment such as Turbo Blowers and biomass boilers. It emphasizes clean production techniques, recycling of waste paper, and energy integration with renewable sources like biogas and solar power. The company also invests in digital transformation with smart manufacturing systems, AI applications, RFID management, and real-time data analytics to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international manufacturers requiring industrial paper, packaging solutions, and household paper products. The company serves industries such as electronics, food, chemical, textile, agriculture, and e-commerce packaging. Markets are primarily domestic Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, especially Vietnam, with exports to Japan and other Asian countries. The company targets both business-to-business clients and end consumers for household paper products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span Taiwan, China (including Guangdong, Suzhou, Chongqing, and other provinces), and Southeast Asia with significant presence in Vietnam (Binh Duong, Bac Giang, Long An, Ben Cat), Indonesia, and Hong Kong. The company maintains production facilities, sales offices, and investment holdings across these regions, leveraging local markets and export opportunities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, producing pulp, paper, and paper-based packaging products. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing (pulp and recycled paper) with downstream manufacturing of finished paper products and packaging solutions. The company also engages in recycling and waste management, supporting circular economy initiatives.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity domestically and overseas, especially in Vietnam, advancing digital transformation and smart manufacturing, and deepening AI integration in operations. R&D focuses on developing low-carbon, sustainable products, optimizing chemical additives, improving energy efficiency, and innovating packaging design aligned with ESG goals. The company invests in renewable energy projects and circular economy practices to enhance sustainability and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of paper, paperboard, paper containers, and household paper products. Additional income streams include sales of related services such as packaging design, printing, and waste recycling. The company also benefits from investments and subsidiaries in related industries, with financial income from overseas holdings and cogeneration operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's paper industry, ranked 61st globally among top paper companies and within the top 100 manufacturing firms in Taiwan. It competes with domestic and international paper manufacturers, focusing on product quality, integrated supply chain, and sustainability leadership. Its vertical integration and overseas expansion provide competitive advantages in cost, technology, and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenue of approximately NT$45.18 billion in 2024, reflecting a 7.1% growth over the previous year. Net profit declined by about 29.6% to NT$656.9 million due to increased costs. Total assets reached NT$72.5 billion with steady growth in equity. The company maintains stable financial health with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and sustainability projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable, green paper products with certifications like FSC and ISO environmental standards. It differentiates through integrated production from pulp to packaging, advanced automation, and digitalization enhancing quality and efficiency. Its commitment to ESG, low-carbon technologies, and circular economy initiatives positions it as a responsible industry leader offering environmentally friendly and innovative paper solutions.
